brief:
The director general of the Palestinian government media office, Dr. Ismail al-Thawabta, accused Israel of continuing military operations and committing what he called "horrific crimes" against unarmed civilians in Gaza without interruption, Shehab Wire reported. He characterized a beach attack as a fresh breach of the ceasefire agreement between the two sides.

Al-Thawabta's statement underscores Palestinian claims that Israeli forces have maintained combat operations despite the truce arrangement. The accusation centers on civilian casualties in the Gaza Strip, where fighting has caused widespread displacement and damage to infrastructure. Palestinian officials have repeatedly cited such incidents as violations of agreed-upon terms meant to halt the violence.

title: Israeli strike on Gaza beach violates ceasefire, Palestinian official says
